regime_context: The detector shows a broad precious-metals-led rotation (9 of 16 themes eligible, not one-narrative) with Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners as the clear 1-2 leaders on momentum rank; the absolute-trend gate is active (gate_helps=true), so staying-power discipline is ON. Macro narrative is noisy and unscheduled-share is 1.0, so this is not a headline-driven regime and I have no external buy triggers.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Oil & Gas Producers (rank 3, eligible) or Base Metals & Copper (rank 4, eligible) can close the margin to the precious-metals leader on a week-over-week basis while Silver & Royalties' durability_bar holds above 0.60 — a confirmed rotation would need Silver to EITHER fall out of eligible status or see durability_bar break below 0.50.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners rank #2 with strong eligible momentum (1.738) and the highest durability_bar (0.67) among the top cohort, plus perfect breadth (1.0), suggesting a persistent, broad-based trend that the absolute-trend gate holds as eligible. As the closest challenger to the leader, a Gold Miners lean is a trend-following, vol-aware expression that does not require timing the Silver→Gold handoff.
evidence: gate_helps=true (trend discipline validated for drawdown control)
theses.dissent: Hurst tag 'mixed' means the trend is not cleanly persistent; XGD.TO is shared with Silver & Royalties, so this leans on the same proxy and adds no independent risk control if precious metals mean-revert.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO trades below its 50-day average on the check-by date, or Gold Miners drops out of eligible status (score below trend gate) for 5 consecutive sessions.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks is the only theme with a 'trend' Hurst tag inside the eligible set, and it is eligible despite modest rank (5th, 0.848). Its low breadth (0.286) means the leadership is narrow, but the trend tag plus eligibility suggests the absolute-trend gate is keeping it alive as a staying-power candidate. The lean is conditional on the trend tag holding.
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.286, meaning the theme is carried by very few names — vulnerable to a single-stock shock; and track_record dir_accuracy is 0.386, so directional conviction should be minimal.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO (Big Banks proxy) lags the S&P/TSX by 3% cumulative before the check-by date, or the theme's Hurst tag flips from 'trend' to 'mixed' or 'mean-revert'.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
